description: Use to reverse any change a tool made to the model (list the recorded runs, preview, then apply). For wind or PD 6694 loads use ec_wind_remove / pd6694_route_a_remove / pd6694_ssi_remove; to take out loads or supports added by hand use civil_remove_loads. Reverses one change a tool made to the model, from the record every apply leaves. Without runId it lists the recent runs (newest first) with what each changed; with runId it previews the undo (what will be deleted or restored) and writes nothing; with runId and apply: true it reverses that run, using the undo of the tool that made it. Undo later work before the model it sits on. Wind loads and PD 6694 loads are taken out with ec_wind_remove / pd6694_route_a_remove / pd6694_ssi_remove instead; the list says so.

apply.description: false (default): preview the undo. true: reverse the run.

force.description: Bridge Reshaper and Bridge Thermal Loads only: undo even though the model changed since the run (their preview says when this is needed).

runId.description: The run to reverse, from the list undo_run gives without runId (or from the apply's result).

tidy.description: Beam to Plate only: also delete nodes left unused.

name: undo_run
title: Undo a recorded change
